integrity: Finite assertions independently enumerate all ordered endpoint perfect matchings through 12 endpoints; weak convergence, asymptotics, and infinite expectation are supplied by analytical arguments rather than finite experiments.
scientific_limitations: The result assumes independent endpoint pairs from a common atomless law. It does not provide a closed positive-value mass function or a convergence rate. A related 1990 primary source could only be checked through its abstract; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: A logarithmic mean and a finite Poisson-corner limit for distance-three pairs in random interval graphs
